boundary.note: The provider here is an application directory, reached through the WaspSourceReader seam. Each interaction is one read: a path in, file text or absence back. test/source-tree.contract.test.ts fakes exactly that reader and drives the real discoverWaspEnv() against the recorded replies.

sourceRefs.confirms: the four general deploy vars DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, WASP_WEB_CLIENT_URL, WASP_SERVER_URL
client env vars must be prefixed REACT_APP_ to reach the browser bundle

boundary.fixtureNote: The recorded file bodies are shortened stand-ins for examples/wasp-opensaas/app/.env.*.example, keeping the key names verbatim and replacing every right-hand side with an obviously fake placeholder. The parser never reads a value, which is the property the FAKE- placeholders make visible.
